result.topic_en: The page gives a complete parametrization, in four families of binary quadratic forms in t and u, of all primitive integer solutions of the ternary quadratic equation 2x^2+3y^2+12z^2+2yz+6xz+8xy=0; the margins hold scattered numerical calculations and upside-down notes on parity conditions.
result.transcription:
Omnes solutiones aequationis

$2xx + 3yy + 12zz + 2yz + 6xz + 8xy = 0$

per numeros integros divisorem communem non habentes
sub aliqua quatuor sequentium formularum:

I $\begin{cases} x = 4tt + 2tu + 9uu \\ y = -8tt - 14tu - 8uu \\ z = -2tt + 4tu + 9uu \end{cases}$

II $\begin{cases} x = 2tt + 2tu + 18uu \\ y = -4tt + 6tu - 6uu \\ z = -tt - 6tu + uu \end{cases}$

III $\begin{cases} x = 3tt + 2tu + 12uu \\ y = -6tt + 6tu - 4uu \\ z = tt + 4tu - 6uu \end{cases}$

IV $\begin{cases} x = 6tt + 2tu + 6uu \\ y = -2tt + 6tu - 12uu \\ z = -3tt + 4tu + 2uu \end{cases}$

denotantibus t, u
integros quoscunque
inter se primos.
